OBJECTIVE: Measure which derived cards in drug_repurposing/join/cards.json remain UNQUALIFIED, classify each (pertinent card unlinked / content needs qualification / insufficient observations / linking would be wrong), link a small high-value batch through the existing mechanism, write the curated cards that are missing where the evidence is already in the repository, regenerate the join outputs and the handoff.
